# Bhanu Pratap Rana — Applied AI Engineer

> Portfolio of Bhanu Pratap Rana (भानु प्रताप राणा), an Applied AI Engineer in Agra, India, working on generative AI, RAG, AI agents, computer vision and FastAPI backends, with a focus on Hindi and other Indian languages. The site includes a copilot that answers questions about his work from a small set of notes using keyword and tag retrieval, with numbered citations.

## Current roles

- Research Assistant (Technical) and AI/ML Engineer, Kendriya Hindi Sansthan (Ministry of Education), Agra. Full-time since March 2025, on the ICSSR-funded "AI Based Remedial Education Model".
- Co-Founder, Aura AI and Media. Part-time since December 2025. AI beauty platform in active development.

## Work

- [ATAL AI 2.0](https://bhanu-xi.vercel.app/projects/atal-ai-2-0): Offline-first Hindi and Assamese learning app with assessments, a voice tutor and teacher dashboards, piloted with 570+ students in six government schools in Assam. Code: https://github.com/bhanu-pratap-rana/ATAL-AI-2.0
- [Hindi Semantic Search System](https://bhanu-xi.vercel.app/projects/hindi-semantic-search): Cross-lingual search and RAG Q&A over 1,633 Hindi book records with MiniLM embeddings, ChromaDB, LangChain and a CrewAI metadata pipeline. Code: https://github.com/bhanu-pratap-rana/Hindi-Books-Semantic-Search-System
- [Voice AI Assistant](https://bhanu-xi.vercel.app/projects/voice-ai-assistant): Real-time voice assistant with Deepgram streaming transcription and a Groq-hosted LLaMA 3.3 70B. Code: https://github.com/bhanu-pratap-rana/voice-assistant
- [Aura AI](https://bhanu-xi.vercel.app/projects/aura-ai): AI beauty platform with facial analysis, skin-tone detection and a GPT-4o assistant on FastAPI, Redis and Celery. Private repository, in development.
- [API Test Case Generator](https://bhanu-xi.vercel.app/projects/api-test-case-generator): Built at Testneo. Generates API tests from documentation with Groq models and ChromaDB retrieval. No public repository.
- [Smart HR Tool](https://bhanu-xi.vercel.app/projects/smart-hr-tool): HR document generator on FastAPI and Streamlit with local Ollama or Groq-hosted models. Code: https://github.com/bhanu-pratap-rana/Smart-HR-Tool
- [Eye Disease Classification](https://bhanu-xi.vercel.app/projects/eye-disease-classification): Transfer learning on 5,335 fundus images across 10 classes; ResNet50 reached 85% accuracy, VGG19 55%. Code: https://github.com/bhanu-pratap-rana/Eye-Image-Classification-Using-VGG19-and-ResNet50
- [Custom Document AI Chatbot](https://bhanu-xi.vercel.app/projects/custom-document-ai-chatbot): OCR, entity recognition and summarisation with Milvus vector search. Code: https://github.com/bhanu-pratap-rana/Custom-Document-AI-chatbot
- [Bolchaal Hindi](https://bhanu-xi.vercel.app/projects/bolchaal-hindi): A 20-day spoken-Hindi course app with voiced dialogues that works offline. Preview; lessons under review. Code: https://github.com/bhanu-pratap-rana/bolchaal-hindi

## Publications and presentations

- Rana, B. P., & Mandusia, A. K. (2026). "Transforming Hindi Library Automation: Semantic Search and AI-Enhanced Metadata." Book chapter, 71st Annual ILA International Conference Proceedings.
- Kumari, S., Rana, B. P., & Tripathi, M. (2025). "Artificial Intelligence and Human Creativity: A Collaborative or Inhibitory Relationship." Shodh Bhumi, Vol. 2, Issue 2.
- Kumari, S., Kumar, A., & Rana, B. P. "Emerging AI Applications for Legal Self-Help in India." National Conference on the Intersection of AI and Law, Amity Law School, August 2025. Best Paper Award, Technical Session 8.
- Rana, B. P. "AI, Technology & Sustainability: A Comparative Study of Neuromorphic Computing and the ATAL AI Web App." ICALS, Manipal University Jaipur, September 2025.
